A cross-platform digital credential wallet: keep and present digital credentials, verify other people's credentials, and keep, check and sign electronic documents. Built on OpenID4VCI 1.0, OpenID4VP 1.0, ISO/IEC 18013-5 and 18013-7,
SD-JWT VC, W3C VC and other standards, and compatible with the Digital Credential Wallet, Bonds, EUDI Wallet and Microsoft Verified ID.

The built-in trust anchors are certificates published by each certificate authority and the Multipaz project, used only to verify certificate chains. Adobe AATL and the EU trusted lists are downloaded and verified in the app; only their signing certificate fingerprints are built in.

When the app opens or comes back, statuses that are due are checked in the background: identity credentials every 30 minutes, government wallet cards every 12 hours, others every 3 days. A change is notified and recorded in the history. The trust lists and blockchain registrations of the issuers of your cards are also checked again every 12 hours.
